structure.unit: Implementation of the Interstate Compact on the Placement of Children

law.catch_line: Discharging financial responsibilities imposed by compact or agreement
law.text: Financial responsibility for any child placed pursuant to the provisions of Chapter 10 (§ 63.2-1000 et seq.) of this title shall be determined in accordance with the provision of Article V of the compact. In the event of partial or complete default of performance thereunder, the provisions of Chapter 19 (§ 63.2-1900 et seq.) of this title may also be invoked.
